implementation.name: original-v2-speculative-decoding
implementation.scope: Declared source outcome trace, exact-algorithm gates but no probability simulation or latency estimate.
implementation.question: Which draft tokens actually become output?

purpose: Separate draft proposals, verification, accepted prefix, and corrected output.
storyboard: Propose T1–T4 sequentially, with no emitted output.
Verify all candidate positions in one target pass.
Accept first three; reject fourth without emitting it.
Sample T4 prime from normalized positive residual.
Continue from accepted prefix plus correction.
guard: No ordinary unconditional p correction; no empirical speedup; reject does not enter emitted sequence; probabilities not simulated.
